domains.name: vessel
domains.description: Manages vessel traffic, scheduling, berthing operations, and marine movements including VTS coordination, anchorage management, ETA/ETB/ATA/ATD tracking, and vessel documentation. Covers vessel profiles (LOA, DWT, GRT, NRT, IMO number), port calls, berth allocation planning, voyage planning, and stowage plans. SSOT for all vessel-related operational data.

products.name: vessel
products.description: Master registry of all vessels calling at the port, including ownership and management hierarchy. Captures the authoritative vessel profile: IMO number, vessel name, flag state (FK to masterdata), vessel type (FK to masterdata), LOA, beam, draft, DWT, GRT, NRT, TEU capacity, call sign, MMSI number, classification society, P&I club, year built, shipyard, and current operational status. Ownership attributes: registered owner, technical manager, commercial operator (disponent owner), ISM company, ship manager, IMO company numbers, country of domicile, and management role types — tracked as SCD Type 2 for ownership change history. Supports ISPS compliance (CSO identification), PSC inspection records, commercial billing relationships, sanctions screening, and vessel risk profiling. SSOT for all vessel identity, static characteristics, and corporate hierarchy referenced across terminal, cargo, marine, and billing domains.

products.name: owner
products.description: Master record of vessel ownership and management entities. Captures registered owner, technical manager, commercial operator (disponent owner), ISM company, and ship manager details including company name, IMO company number, country of domicile, contact details, and management role type. Tracks ownership changes and management transfers over time. Supports ISPS compliance (CSO identification), PSC inspection records, commercial billing relationships, and sanctions screening. Distinct from the customer domain which tracks port community participants as commercial clients — this product captures the vessel's corporate hierarchy as declared in IMO records.

products.name: call
products.description: Core transactional record representing a single vessel visit to the port, from pre-arrival notification through departure. Captures: voyage number, POL, POD, ETA/ETB/ETD, ATA/ATB/ATD, call purpose (loading, discharge, bunkering, transit, lay-up, crew change), cargo type, total TEU/FEU declared, call status, VTS clearance reference. Agent appointment attributes: appointed agent company, agency type (general, husbanding, cargo, protective), appointment scope (single call, voyage series, annual), appointment dates, primary contact, and appointment status. Milestone timestamps: pilot boarded, first line, all fast, gangway down, cargo ops start/end, last line, pilot off. The primary operational anchor entity linking vessel movements to berth allocation, cargo operations, pilotage, towage, and billing. Supports SLA measurement, port call performance reporting (UNCTAD indicators), and agent coordination for document submission authority and billing address routing.

products.name: voyage
products.description: Master record of a vessel voyage representing the commercial and operational journey between ports. Captures voyage number, voyage type (inbound, outbound, coastal, international), service route, shipping line service code, origin port, destination port, intermediate ports of call sequence, voyage start and end dates, and voyage status. Links to port calls at each port of call and supports stowage planning (BAPLIE), cargo manifest reconciliation, and freight billing. Distinct from port_call which represents the single-port visit event.

attributes.description: Reference to the shipping line or carrier operating this voyage. Links to the participant account representing the commercial operator responsible for the voyage.

attributes.name: atd

attributes.name: baplie_received_flag

attributes.name: berth_productivity_target

attributes.name: call_sequence

attributes.name: cargo_manifest_received_flag

attributes.name: coparn_received_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator showing whether the COPARN (Container Pre-Announcement) EDI message has been received. COPARN provides advance notice of containers to be discharged and loaded.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this voyage record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: customs_clearance_status
attributes.description: Current status of customs clearance for the voyage cargo. Pending indicates awaiting customs processing, cleared indicates all cargo approved for release, inspection_required indicates physical examination needed, hold indicates customs detention, released indicates cargo available for delivery.
attributes.references: WCO Revised Kyoto Convention - Customs Procedures

attributes.name: destination_port_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE of the voyage destination port. Five-character code identifying the final port of call for this voyage leg.

attributes.name: empty_teu_onboard
attributes.description: The number of empty containers onboard measured in TEU. Critical for empty container repositioning planning and depot management.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Container Classification and TEU Standard

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when the voyage concluded at the destination port. Represents the actual or planned arrival date marking the end of the commercial voyage journey.

attributes.name: eta
attributes.description: The estimated timestamp when the vessel is expected to arrive at the port. Updated throughout the voyage based on vessel position, speed, and weather conditions. Critical for berth planning and resource allocation.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention - Estimated Arrival Reporting

attributes.name: etb
attributes.description: The estimated timestamp when the vessel is expected to berth at the assigned quay. Accounts for pilotage, towage, and berth availability. Used for terminal operations planning and gate scheduling.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Operations - Berth Planning Standards

attributes.name: etd
attributes.description: The estimated timestamp when the vessel is expected to depart from the berth. Based on cargo operations completion forecast, customs clearance, and next port schedule requirements.

attributes.name: omission_reason
attributes.description: Textual explanation for why a scheduled port call was omitted. Common reasons include weather delays, mechanical issues, insufficient cargo, port congestion, or schedule recovery actions.

attributes.name: oog_cargo_onboard_flag

attributes.name: previous_port_code

attributes.name: quarantine_status

attributes.name: reefer_teu_onboard

attributes.name: remarks

attributes.name: rotation_number
attributes.description: Sequential rotation identifier within the service string. Used by shipping lines to track vessel position within a cyclical service route (e.g., rotation 1, rotation 2). Supports schedule adherence analysis.

attributes.name: service_code
attributes.description: The shipping line's service route code or string identifier for the regular service this voyage belongs to. Used to group voyages into service patterns for schedule analysis and capacity planning.
attributes.references: Shipping Line Service Schedules - Industry Standard

attributes.name: service_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the shipping service route (e.g., Asia-Europe Express, Pacific Loop Service). Provides business context for the voyage's commercial service pattern.
attributes.references: Shipping Line Service Schedules - Industry Standard

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the voyage commenced from the origin port. Represents the actual or planned departure date marking the beginning of the commercial voyage journey.

attributes.name: total_teu_capacity
attributes.description: The total container capacity of the vessel for this voyage measured in TEU. Represents the maximum number of twenty-foot equivalent containers the vessel can carry.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Container Classification and TEU Standard

attributes.name: towage_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator showing whether tug assistance is required for berthing and unberthing operations. Based on vessel size, maneuverability, weather conditions, and port regulations.

attributes.name: voyage_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique voyage number assigned by the shipping line or port authority. This is the business identifier used in operational communications, manifests, and port call documentation.

attributes.name: voyage_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the voyage. Planned indicates initial voyage planning stage, scheduled indicates confirmed berth and resource allocation, in_progress indicates vessel is actively executing the voyage, completed indicates voyage has concluded with vessel departure, cancelled indicates voyage was terminated before execution, delayed indicates voyage is behind schedule.

attributes.name: voyage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the voyage based on direction and scope. Inbound indicates arrival to the port, outbound indicates departure, coastal indicates domestic port-to-port movement, international indicates cross-border movement, feeder indicates short-sea collection/distribution service, and transshipment indicates cargo transfer voyage.

products.name: movement
products.description: Granular transactional record of each discrete vessel movement event within port waters as tracked by the VTS (Vessel Traffic Service). Captures movement type (arrival, departure, shifting, anchorage entry/exit, canal transit), movement timestamp, position at movement (latitude/longitude), speed over ground, heading, pilot on board flag, tug assistance flag, VTS clearance number, reporting channel, and movement status. Provides the detailed audit trail of vessel traffic for VTMS reporting, safety investigations, and port throughput analytics.

attributes.name: port_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.port_location. Business justification: Vessel movements generate costs (pilotage, VTS coordination, tug operations oversight) allocated to marine services cost centres. Essential for activity-based costing of vessel traffic management, pil

attributes.name: vessel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel performing this movement. Links to vessel master data.

attributes.name: air_draft_meters
attributes.description: Vertical distance from the waterline to the highest point of the vessel at the time of movement, measured in meters. Critical for clearance under bridges and overhead structures.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this movement record was first created in the system. Audit trail timestamp for record creation.

attributes.name: current_direction_degrees
attributes.description: Water current direction at the time of movement, expressed in degrees (0-360). Indicates the direction toward which the current is flowing.

attributes.name: current_speed_knots
attributes.description: Water current speed at the time of movement, measured in knots. Affects vessel handling and is recorded for navigation safety analysis.

attributes.name: dangerous_cargo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vessel is carrying dangerous goods (IMDG cargo) during this movement. True if dangerous cargo is on board, False otherwise. Triggers special handling and notification procedures.

attributes.name: delay_minutes
attributes.description: Delay time in minutes compared to scheduled movement timestamp. Positive value indicates late movement, zero indicates on-time. Used for SLA (Service Level Agreement) performance tracking.

attributes.name: delay_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for movement delay. References delay reason lookup table. Null if movement was on time.

attributes.name: destination_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the ending location of the movement. May reference a berth, anchorage, or port boundary point. For departures, this is typically the port exit or pilot disembarkation point.

attributes.name: draft_aft_meters
attributes.description: Vessel's draft at the aft perpendicular at the time of movement, measured in meters. Used with forward draft to calculate trim and ensure safe passage.

attributes.name: draft_forward_meters
attributes.description: Vessel's draft at the forward perpendicular at the time of movement, measured in meters. Critical for safe navigation and channel depth clearance verification.

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the movement from start to completion, measured in minutes. Used for operational efficiency analysis and billing calculations.

attributes.name: heading_degrees
attributes.description: Vessel's heading in degrees (0-360) at the time of movement. 0/360 represents North, 90 represents East, 180 represents South, 270 represents West.

attributes.name: isps_security_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Security Level
attributes.description: ISPS security level in effect at the time of movement. Level 1 is normal, Level 2 is heightened, Level 3 is exceptional. Affects movement procedures and clearance requirements.

attributes.name: longitude

attributes.name: movement_status

attributes.name: movement_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time when the movement event occurred. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Recorded in UTC and converted to local port time for operational reporting.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention - Time Recording Standards

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the movement event. Defines the nature of the vessel's movement within port waters: arrival (entering port), departure (leaving port), shifting (moving between berths), anchorage entry/exit, or canal transit.

attributes.name: number_of_tugs
attributes.description: Count of tug vessels assisting with this movement. Zero if no tug assistance was provided. Used for resource planning and billing.

attributes.name: origin_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the starting location of the movement. May reference a berth, anchorage, or port boundary point. For arrivals, this is typically the port entrance or pilot boarding ground.

attributes.name: pilot_on_board_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a marine pilot was on board the vessel during this movement. True if pilot was present, False otherwise. Critical for safety and regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes and observations recorded by VTS operators or pilots during the movement. Captures special circumstances, incidents, or noteworthy events.

attributes.name: scheduled_movement_timestamp
attributes.description: The planned date and time for the movement event. Used for comparison against actual movement timestamp to calculate delays and measure operational performance.

attributes.name: speed_over_ground_knots
attributes.description: Vessel's speed over ground at the time of movement, measured in knots. Captured from AIS (Automatic Identification System) or VTS radar tracking.

attributes.name: tide_height_meters
attributes.description: Tidal height above chart datum at the time of movement, measured in meters. Critical for under-keel clearance calculations.

attributes.name: tug_assistance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether tug assistance was provided during this movement. True if tugs were used, False otherwise. Important for operational cost allocation and safety analysis.

attributes.name: visibility_meters
attributes.description: Horizontal visibility distance at the time of movement, measured in meters. Critical safety parameter for navigation in restricted waters.

attributes.name: vts_clearance_number
attributes.description: Unique clearance reference number issued by VTS (Vessel Traffic Service) authorizing this movement. Required for all movements within VTS-controlled waters per SOLAS regulations.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Chapter V - VTS Requirements

attributes.name: vts_reporting_channel
attributes.description: VHF radio channel used for VTS communication during this movement. Typically a designated port operations channel (e.g., Channel 12, Channel 14).

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Prevailing weather conditions at the time of movement. Recorded for safety analysis and incident investigation purposes.

attributes.name: wind_direction_degrees
attributes.description: Wind direction at the time of movement, expressed in degrees (0-360). 0/360 represents wind from North.

attributes.name: wind_speed_knots
attributes.description: Wind speed at the time of movement, measured in knots. Affects vessel maneuverability and is recorded for safety analysis.

products.name: certificate
products.description: Unified vessel compliance record encompassing statutory/class certificates and Port State Control (PSC) inspections that verify them. For certificates: captures certificate type (SOLAS Safety Construction, Load Line, MARPOL IOPP, ISM DOC/SMC, ISPS ISSC, MLC, Tonnage, Classification, CLC/Bunker Convention), issuing authority (flag state or RO), certificate number, issue date, expiry date, survey due dates (annual, intermediate, renewal), and certificate status (valid, expired, suspended, withdrawn). For PSC inspections: captures inspection date, PSC authority (Paris MOU, Tokyo MOU, Indian Ocean MOU, etc.), inspecting officer, inspection type (initial, expanded, concentrated inspection campaign), deficiency codes per MOU conventions, total deficiencies, detention flag, detention start/end dates, rectification deadline, inspection outcome, and follow-up actions. Provides the unified vessel compliance profile supporting port entry eligibility checks, PSC targeting (ship risk profile calculation), detention history analysis, and flag state performance monitoring.

attributes.name: certificate_type
attributes.description: Type of statutory or class certificate. SOLAS (Safety of Life at Sea) certificates include Safety Construction, Safety Equipment, Safety Radio. MARPOL (Marine Pollution Convention) certificates include IOPP (International Oil Pollution Prevention), NLS (Noxious Liquid Substances). products.name: port_call
products.description: This association product represents the operational event of a vessel calling at a specific port location. It captures the complete port call lifecycle including arrival, berthing, operations, and departure. Each record links one vessel to one port location with attributes that track call-specific operational data, performance metrics, and access control decisions. This is the foundational operational record for terminal operations, marine services billing, and vessel performance analytics.. Existence Justification: In maritime port operations, vessels make multiple calls at multiple port locations throughout their operational life, and each port location receives thousands of vessels over time. Each port call is a distinct operational event with its own lifecycle (arrival, berthing, operations, departure), performance metrics, cargo volumes, charges, and access control decisions. Port calls are actively managed by marine operations teams as standalone business events with rich operational data.

products.name: container_visit
products.description: Transactional record of a container's complete terminal visit lifecycle from arrival (gate-in, vessel discharge, or rail-in) to departure (gate-out, vessel load, or rail-out). Captures container number, ISO type code (per BIC/ISO 6346), size (TEU/FEU), visit status (inbound, in-yard, outbound, departed), current yard slot position, vessel visit reference, BOL reference, cargo type, VGM weight (SOLAS), seal numbers, damage flags, reefer temperature settings, IMDG class, TOS tracking identifiers, and dwell time. Core operational entity linking all terminal activities — gate transactions, equipment moves, reefer monitoring, service orders, and hazmat declarations reference this record. attributes.description: The cumulative operating hours of the refrigeration compressor since last reset. Used for maintenance scheduling and equipment lifecycle management.

attributes.name: compressor_status
attributes.description: The operational status of the refrigeration compressor unit. Running indicates active cooling, stopped indicates unit off, standby indicates ready but not cooling, fault indicates malfunction.

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Free text description of the corrective action taken or required in response to this monitoring event. Populated when intervention was necessary.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this monitoring event requires corrective action or intervention. True indicates follow-up action needed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this monitoring record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: defrost_cycle_status
attributes.description: The status of the automatic defrost cycle for the refrigeration unit. Active indicates defrost in progress, inactive indicates normal cooling mode, scheduled indicates defrost pending.

attributes.name: door_status
attributes.description: The physical status of the reefer container door. Closed indicates door shut but not sealed, open indicates door ajar or open, sealed indicates door closed with customs or security seal intact.

attributes.name: humidity_reading
attributes.description: The relative humidity percentage measured inside the reefer container. Important for cargo types sensitive to moisture levels such as fresh produce.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this monitoring record was last modified in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: monitoring_source
attributes.description: The method or system that captured this monitoring reading. Automated sensor indicates TOS integration, manual inspection indicates technician reading, remote telemetry indicates IoT device, RFID reader indicates tag-based monitoring.

attributes.name: monitoring_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this monitoring event. Active indicates ongoing monitoring, resolved indicates issue closed, escalated indicates elevated to management, pending review indicates awaiting technician assessment.

attributes.name: monitoring_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the reefer container monitoring reading was captured. Principal business event timestamp for this monitoring transaction.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether an alert notification was sent to stakeholders for this monitoring event. True indicates notification dispatched to customer or operations team.

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when alert notification was sent to stakeholders regarding this monitoring event. Null if no notification was sent.

attributes.name: o2_level
attributes.description: The oxygen concentration measured inside the reefer container in percentage. Used for controlled atmosphere monitoring to preserve perishable cargo.

attributes.name: power_status
attributes.description: The electrical power connection status of the reefer container. Connected indicates active power supply, disconnected indicates no power, standby indicates backup power mode.

attributes.name: power_supply_voltage
attributes.description: The electrical voltage being supplied to the reefer container in volts. Standard voltages are 220V, 380V, or 440V depending on terminal infrastructure.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free text field for additional notes, observations, or comments related to this reefer monitoring event. Used by technicians and operations staff for context.

attributes.name: sensor_device_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the monitoring sensor or telemetry device that captured this reading. Used for device calibration tracking and data quality assurance.

attributes.name: set_temperature
attributes.description: The target temperature setting configured for the reefer container in degrees Celsius. This is the temperature the refrigeration unit is programmed to maintain.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this monitoring event represents a breach of customer service level agreement for reefer monitoring. True indicates SLA breach occurred.

attributes.name: temperature_deviation
attributes.description: The calculated difference between set temperature and actual temperature in degrees. Positive values indicate warmer than set point, negative values indicate cooler than set point.

attributes.name: temperature_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for temperature readings. Standard is Celsius but Fahrenheit may be used in some jurisdictions.

attributes.name: ventilation_rate
attributes.description: The air exchange rate in cubic meters per hour when ventilation is active. Applicable for cargo requiring fresh air circulation.

attributes.name: ventilation_setting
attributes.description: The ventilation mode configured for the reefer container. Closed for frozen cargo, open for fresh air exchange, controlled for modified atmosphere.

products.name: equipment
products.description: Master data for all terminal handling equipment (THE) units operated within the terminal. Captures equipment number, equipment type (RTG, STS/QC, ASC, MHC, AGV, reach stacker, empty handler, forklift, terminal tractor), make, model, year of manufacture, SWL (Safe Working Load), operational status (active, under maintenance, standby, decommissioned), current yard zone assignment, fuel/power type, and Maximo asset reference. SSOT for terminal equipment identity within the terminal domain (operational profile; full asset lifecycle owned by asset domain).

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the terminal handling equipment unit. Primary key for the terminal equipment master data.

attributes.name: berth_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.berth. Business justification: STS cranes and other quayside equipment are physically installed at specific berths. Berth crane-count validation, maintenance scheduling, and berth productivity (moves-per-hour) reporting all require

attributes.name: maintenance_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.maintenance_plan. Business justification: Equipment dispatch planning requires TOS to check active maintenance windows before assigning RTGs, STS cranes, or reach stackers to work. Linking terminal_equipment directly to its maintenance_plan e

attributes.name: port_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.port_asset. Business justification: Terminal equipment are port assets tracked in both operational (terminal_equipment) and financial (port_asset) systems. Required for depreciation reporting, capital expenditure tracking, asset valuati

attributes.name: port_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.port_location. Business justification: Terminal equipment assets are assigned to cost centers for depreciation allocation, maintenance cost tracking, and operational cost reporting. Each equipment unit has a home cost center for financial

attributes.name: terminal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to terminal.terminal. Business justification: Terminal equipment (RTGs, STS cranes, ASCs, MHCs, reach stackers) are owned and operated by a specific terminal. The existing home_terminal STRING column is a denormalized text representation of the t

attributes.name: terminal_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.terminal_zone. Business justification: Equipment is assigned to specific terminal zones for operational dispatch, maintenance planning, and resource allocation. The existing 'home_terminal' text field is insufficient; equipment dispatch sy

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the equipment was acquired by the port authority, either through purchase, lease commencement, or transfer. Used for asset accounting, depreciation start date, and fleet age analysis.

attributes.name: automation_level
attributes.description: Degree of automation for equipment operation. Manual requires on-board operator, semi_automated provides operator assistance systems, fully_automated operates without human intervention (e.g., ASC, AGV), remote_controlled operated from remote control station. Critical for operational planning, safety protocols, and workforce requirements.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Automated Equipment Management

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the equipments current safety certification or inspection certificate. Equipment must not operate beyond this date without recertification per port safety regulations and SOLAS requirements.
attributes.references: SOLAS (Safety of Life at Sea); Port State Control (PSC) - Equipment Certification

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the equipment was commissioned and entered active operational service at the terminal. May differ from acquisition date due to installation, testing, and certification periods.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this equipment master record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: current_yard_zone
attributes.description: Current yard zone or operational area where the equipment is assigned or located. Used for dispatch optimization, equipment utilization tracking, and operational planning. Typically references yard block identifiers from terminal layout.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Yard Management

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used for calculating depreciation of the equipment asset. Used for financial reporting, tax compliance, and asset valuation per accounting standards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA ERP - Asset Accounting; IFRS 16 Leases

attributes.name: emission_standard
attributes.description: Environmental emission standard that the equipment complies with (e.g., EPA Tier 4, Euro Stage V). Used for environmental reporting, regulatory compliance, and green port initiatives. Critical for GHG emissions tracking and air quality management.
attributes.references: MARPOL (Marine Pollution Convention); ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: equipment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the terminal handling equipment unit. Used for operational dispatch, maintenance tracking, and cross-system reference. Typically alphanumeric code assigned by terminal operations or manufacturer.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Equipment Master

attributes.name: fuel_power_type
attributes.description: Primary energy source or propulsion type for the equipment. Critical for environmental reporting (GHG emissions), operational cost tracking, refueling/recharging infrastructure planning, and compliance with port environmental regulations.
attributes.references: MARPOL (Marine Pollution Convention) - Port Environmental Standards; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: gps_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment is equipped with active GPS tracking capability for real-time location monitoring. Used for fleet management, utilization analysis, and operational optimization.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Equipment Tracking

attributes.name: imdg_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code Certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment is certified and equipped for handling dangerous goods containers per IMDG Code requirements. Includes specialized safety features, operator training requirements, and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: IMDG (International Maritime Dangerous Goods) Code; SOLAS (Safety of Life at Sea)

tag_set.value: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code Certified

attributes.name: insurance_policy_reference
attributes.description: Reference number for the insurance policy covering this equipment. Used for risk management, claims processing, and asset protection. Links to Protection and Indemnity (P&I) or equipment insurance policies.

attributes.name: last_major_overhaul_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent major overhaul or refurbishment of the equipment. Used for maintenance planning, remaining useful life estimation, and capital expenditure tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this equipment master record was last modified. Used for data currency verification, change tracking, and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: maximo_asset_reference
attributes.description: Cross-reference identifier linking this terminal equipment record to the corresponding asset record in Maximo Asset Management system. Enables integration between operational equipment master (TOS) and full asset lifecycle management (EAM) for maintenance, work orders, and asset financial tracking.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management - Asset Master Integration

attributes.name: maximum_lift_height_metres
attributes.description: Maximum vertical lift height of the equipment in metres. Applicable to cranes and lifting equipment, indicates the maximum container stack height or vessel reach capability. Critical for operational planning and safety.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Terminal Equipment Specifications

attributes.name: maximum_reach_metres
attributes.description: Maximum horizontal reach or span of the equipment in metres. Applicable to cranes (STS, QC, MHC, RTG, ASC) and indicates the operational envelope for cargo handling. Used for berth planning and yard layout optimization.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Terminal Equipment Specifications

attributes.name: next_scheduled_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the next planned preventive maintenance activity for the equipment. Used for maintenance scheduling, resource planning, and operational availability forecasting.

attributes.name: noise_level_db
attributes.description: Measured operational noise level of the equipment in decibels. Used for occupational health and safety compliance, environmental impact assessment, and noise pollution management per port environmental regulations.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: operating_hours_since_last_service
attributes.description: Operating hours accumulated since the last scheduled maintenance service. Used to trigger interval-based preventive maintenance activities.

attributes.name: operating_hours_total
attributes.description: Cumulative total operating hours recorded for the equipment since commissioning. Used for usage-based maintenance scheduling, depreciation calculations, and equipment lifecycle analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle state of the terminal handling equipment. Active indicates available for dispatch, under_maintenance indicates scheduled or unscheduled maintenance in progress, standby indicates operational but not currently assigned, decommissioned indicates permanently retired from service, out_of_service indicates temporarily unavailable, awaiting_repair indicates breakdown pending repair.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Equipment Status Management

attributes.name: operator_certification_required
attributes.description: Type or level of operator certification required to operate this equipment. References specific training programs, licensing requirements, or competency standards per port safety regulations and Maritime Labour Convention.
attributes.references: ILO (International Labour Organization) - Maritime Labour Convention; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Legal ownership or control arrangement for the equipment. Owned indicates port authority owns the asset, leased indicates long-term lease arrangement, rented indicates short-term rental, contractor_provided indicates equipment supplied by third-party service contractor.

attributes.name: reefer_monitoring_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment is equipped with systems to monitor refrigerated container (reefer) parameters during handling or storage. Applicable to yard equipment and critical for cold chain integrity.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Reefer Management

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, operational constraints, or historical information about the equipment. Used for operational knowledge capture and equipment-specific context.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Equipment Master

attributes.name: replacement_value
attributes.description: Current estimated replacement cost for the equipment in base currency. Used for insurance valuation, capital planning, and asset management decisions. Updated periodically to reflect market conditions.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the RFID tag attached to the equipment for automated tracking and identification within the terminal. Used for real-time location tracking, automated gate operations, and equipment utilization monitoring.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - RFID Integration

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned unique serial number for the equipment unit. Used for warranty claims, recall tracking, and asset provenance verification.

attributes.name: spreader_type
attributes.description: Type of spreader attachment fitted to the equipment for container handling. Applicable to cranes and reach stackers. Fixed spreaders handle single container size, telescopic spreaders adjust between 20ft and 40ft containers, tandem spreaders handle two containers simultaneously. Critical for operational flexibility and productivity.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System - Equipment Configuration

attributes.name: swl_tonnes
attributes.description: Maximum safe working load capacity of the equipment expressed in metric tonnes. Critical safety parameter for operational dispatch and cargo handling planning. Must not be exceeded during operations per SOLAS and port safety regulations.
attributes.references: SOLAS (Safety of Life at Sea) - Cargo Handling Safety; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: tandem_lift_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment is capable of lifting two Forty-foot Equivalent Unit (FEU) containers simultaneously. Applicable to high-capacity cranes and represents advanced productivity capability.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Terminal Productivity Standards

attributes.name: telematics_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the telematics system or IoT device installed on the equipment for remote monitoring of performance, diagnostics, and operational parameters. Used for predictive maintenance and real-time equipment health monitoring.

attributes.name: twin_lift_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment is capable of lifting two Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit (TEU) containers simultaneously. Applicable to cranes and significantly impacts productivity for vessel and yard operations.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Terminal Productivity Standards

attributes.name: year_of_manufacture
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the equipment was manufactured. Used for age-based maintenance planning, depreciation calculations, and lifecycle management decisions.

products.name: terminal
products.description: Master reference table for terminal. Referenced by terminal_id.

attributes.name: terminal_id
attributes.description: Primary key for terminal

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organization entity that operates this terminal.

attributes.name: port_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.port. Business justification: Every terminal operates within a port. Port authority reporting, port-level throughput aggregation, regulatory submissions, and port master-data governance all require the terminal → port relationship

attributes.name: port_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent port or seaport where this terminal is located.

attributes.name: port_tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.port_tariff. Business justification: Each terminal operates under a published master port tariff governing all charges (storage, handling, wharfage, dues). Regulatory filings, customer quotations, and billing systems require linking term

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the terminal facility.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details (building, suite, zone).

attributes.name: annual_throughput_capacity_teu
attributes.description: Maximum annual container handling capacity measured in TEU. Represents the designed throughput volume the terminal can process per year.

attributes.name: cfs_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total area of the Container Freight Station facility measured in square meters.

attributes.name: cfs_facility_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal has a Container Freight Station (CFS) for Less than Container Load (LCL) cargo consolidation and deconsolidation.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City where the terminal is located.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for terminal operations and business communications.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for terminal operations and inquiries.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the terminal is located.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this terminal record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customs_bonded_area
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal operates a customs bonded area for duty-deferred cargo storage.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal is certified to handle dangerous goods (hazardous materials) per IMDG Code requirements.

attributes.name: gate_lanes_inbound
attributes.description: Number of dedicated inbound gate lanes for truck entry and container delivery to the terminal.

attributes.name: gate_lanes_outbound
attributes.description: Number of dedicated outbound gate lanes for truck exit and container pickup from the terminal.

attributes.name: iso_28000_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal holds ISO 28000 certification for supply chain security management.

attributes.name: isps_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal is compliant with the International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code for maritime security.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the terminal location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the terminal location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: max_vessel_draft_m
attributes.description: Maximum vessel draft (depth below waterline) that the terminal berths can accommodate, measured in meters. Determines the size of vessels that can safely berth.

attributes.name: max_vessel_loa_m
attributes.description: Maximum vessel Length Overall (LOA) that the terminal can accommodate, measured in meters. Critical for determining compatible vessel classes.

attributes.name: number_of_asc_cranes
attributes.description: Total count of Automated Stacking Cranes (ASC) deployed for automated container yard operations.

attributes.name: number_of_berths
attributes.description: Total count of vessel berths available at the terminal for simultaneous vessel operations.

attributes.name: number_of_mhc_units
attributes.description: Total count of Mobile Harbour Cranes (MHC) available for multipurpose cargo handling operations.

attributes.name: number_of_reach_stackers
attributes.description: Total count of reach stacker vehicles used for container handling and stacking in the yard.

attributes.name: number_of_rtg_cranes
attributes.description: Total count of Rubber-Tyred Gantry (RTG) cranes used for container stacking and yard operations.

attributes.name: number_of_sts_cranes
attributes.description: Total count of Ship-to-Shore (STS) gantry cranes available for loading and unloading containers from vessels. Also known as Quay Cranes (QC).

attributes.name: operational_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the terminal commenced commercial operations.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the terminal facility in its lifecycle.

attributes.name: operator_name
attributes.description: Name of the company or entity operating the terminal facility.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the terminal location.

attributes.name: reefer_plugs_available
attributes.description: Total number of electrical connection points (plugs) available for refrigerated (reefer) containers requiring temperature control.

attributes.name: rfid_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the terminal has deployed RFID technology for automated container tracking and gate operations.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province where the terminal is located.

attributes.name: storage_capacity_teu
attributes.description: Maximum container storage capacity measured in Twenty-foot Equivalent Units (TEU). Represents the total number of standard 20-foot containers the terminal can hold.

attributes.name: terminal_type
attributes.description: Classification of terminal based on primary cargo handling operations. Container terminals handle TEU/FEU, RoRo handles roll-on/roll-off vehicles, bulk handles commodities.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the terminal location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/Rotterdam).

attributes.name: tos_system
attributes.description: Primary Terminal Operating System deployed for yard management, gate operations, and equipment dispatch. NAVIS N4 and TOPS Expert are industry-leading platforms.

attributes.name: total_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total land area of the terminal facility measured in square meters, including container yards, warehouses, and operational zones.

attributes.name: total_quay_length_m
attributes.description: Total length of quay wall available for vessel berthing, measured in meters.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this terminal record was last modified in the system.

domains.name: cargo
domains.description: Manages cargo handling, loading/discharge operations, stowage planning (BAPLIE), dangerous goods (IMDG), FCL/LCL management, BOL processing, and cargo documentation. Covers cargo manifests, POL/POD tracking, container pre-announcement (COPARN), delivery orders (D/O), HS Code assignment, and cargo condition monitoring. SSOT for cargo movement and handling data.

products.name: shipment
products.description: Core master entity representing a cargo consignment moving through the port, from pre-arrival notification to final delivery or transshipment. Captures shipper/consignee parties, POL/POD routing, cargo type (FCL/LCL/RoRo/LoLo/Bulk), commodity description, HS Code reference, weight (MT), volume (CBM), TEU/FEU count, booking and BOL references, vessel call linkage, IMDG classification where applicable, and cargo lifecycle status. SSOT for cargo consignment identity within the port ecosystem.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cargo shipment consignment moving through the port. Primary key for the shipment entity. System-generated surrogate key used across all port systems to track this cargo movement from pre-arrival notification through final delivery or transshipment.

attributes.name: commodity_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.commodity_code. Business justification: Cargo shipments reference commodity codes for classification, tariff determination, and regulatory compliance. Currently shipment has hs_code as a string. Adding FK to masterdata.commodity_code enable

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: Shipments must be screened against trade restrictions (embargoes, sanctions, prohibited goods). Real regulatory requirement: export control compliance, sanctions enforcement. Booking systems verify sh

attributes.name: customs_broker_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.customs_broker. Business justification: Shipments are cleared by customs brokers. Real business process: broker assignment, declaration submission, clearance coordination. Shippers appoint brokers per shipment; port community systems track

attributes.name: discharge_berth_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to infrastructure.berth. Business justification: Shipments are discharged at specific berths; essential for vessel operations planning, berth allocation, and cargo tracking. Port operators must know which berth each shipment was handled at for opera

attributes.name: imdg_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.packaging_type. Business justification: Shipments declare package types for customs compliance, SOLAS VGM validation, and dangerous goods packaging verification. Linking to packaging_type master enables automated validation of IMDG packagin

attributes.name: isps_facility_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.isps_facility_record. Business justification: High-risk shipments (origin, commodity, shipper profile) trigger threat assessments under ISPS Code. Links shipment to formal threat evaluation, enabling risk-based cargo screening, enhanced security

attributes.name: participant_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.agreement. Business justification: Shipments operate under service agreements with shipping lines or terminal operators defining rates, service levels, and terms. Essential for billing validation, rate application, and SLA tracking in

attributes.name: pol_port_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.port_location. Business justification: Shipment requires structured pol_port_location_id for origin terminal operations, export documentation, customs zone determination, and loading berth assignment. Replaces denormalized pol_port_code wi

attributes.name: port_tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.port_tariff. Business justification: Shipments are charged according to applicable port tariff schedules. Port billing systems must link each shipment to the tariff schedule governing its charges for invoicing and revenue recognition. Es

attributes.name: primary_shipment_consignee_port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (organization or individual) receiving the cargo. The consignee to whom the goods are being shipped and who will take delivery at destination.

attributes.name: primary_shipment_onward_vessel_call_id
attributes.description: Reference to the next vessel call for transshipment cargo. Links the shipment to the outbound vessel on which it will continue its journey. Populated only when is_transshipment is true.

attributes.name: shipping_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.shipping_line. Business justification: Shipments are contracted with carriers; shipping_line_id identifies the contracted carrier for freight terms enforcement, service level tracking, schedule reliability measurement, and commercial relat

attributes.name: tertiary_shipment_port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (organization or individual) shipping the cargo. The consignor who is sending the goods and typically appears on the Bill of Lading as the shipper.

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading number serving as the contract of carriage and receipt for goods. Critical document reference for cargo ownership, customs clearance, and delivery authorization. May be Master BOL or House BOL depending on shipment type.

attributes.name: cargo_condition
attributes.description: Physical condition of the cargo as observed during handling operations. Documented for liability, insurance claims, and dispute resolution. Updated during discharge, inspection, and delivery.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Cargo Condition Reporting

attributes.name: cargo_type
attributes.description: Classification of cargo handling method: FCL (Full Container Load), LCL (Less than Container Load), RoRo (Roll-on Roll-off), LoLo (Lift-on Lift-off), Bulk, or Breakbulk. Determines handling equipment, storage requirements, and operational procedures.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Cargo Handling Standards

attributes.name: commodity_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the cargo commodity being shipped. Provides human-readable detail about the goods for operational, customs, and commercial purposes. Complements the HS Code classification.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) - Cargo Declaration Standards

attributes.name: container_count
attributes.description: Total number of physical containers (of any size) associated with this shipment. Used for gate operations, yard planning, and equipment tracking. Applicable only to containerized cargo types (FCL/LCL).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shipment record was first created in the port system. Audit field for data lineage and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: declared_value_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Declared Cargo Value in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Declared commercial value of the cargo in US Dollars. Used for customs valuation, insurance coverage, and liability limits. May differ from actual market value.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) - Customs Valuation Agreement

tag_set.value: Declared Cargo Value in United States Dollars (USD)

attributes.name: delivery_order_issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the Delivery Order was issued by the shipping line or port authority. Marks the point when cargo becomes available for pickup by the consignee.

attributes.name: delivery_order_number
attributes.description: Delivery Order number authorizing the release of cargo to the consignee or their agent. Required document for gate-out operations and proof of delivery authorization.

attributes.name: discharge_date
attributes.description: Date when the cargo was physically discharged from the vessel at the berth. Key operational milestone for calculating vessel turnaround time and initiating yard operations.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Vessel Planning - Discharge Operations

attributes.name: feu_count
attributes.description: Number of Forty-foot Equivalent Units represented by this shipment. Alternative measure for containerized cargo, particularly for larger containers. Used alongside TEU for operational reporting.
attributes.references: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) - ISO 668 Container Standards

attributes.name: final_destination_port_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE for the ultimate destination port if different from POD. Used for transshipment cargo where the current port is an intermediate stop.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: freight_terms
attributes.description: Terms indicating who is responsible for freight payment: Prepaid (shipper pays), Collect (consignee pays), or Third-Party (another party pays). Affects billing and revenue allocation.
attributes.references: International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) - Incoterms Standards

attributes.name: gate_out_date
attributes.description: Date when the cargo exited the port terminal through the gate. Marks final delivery or transfer to inland transport. Used for dwell time calculation and billing finalization.

attributes.name: gross_weight_mt
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the shipment including packaging and container tare weight, measured in metric tons. Used for vessel stowage planning, berth load calculations, and billing.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) - SOLAS Verified Gross Mass Requirements

attributes.name: imdg_class
attributes.description: IMDG classification code for dangerous goods (e.g., Class 3 for flammable liquids, Class 8 for corrosives). Determines handling procedures, storage segregation, and emergency response protocols. Populated only when is_dangerous_goods is true.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) - IMDG Code Classification

attributes.name: incoterm
attributes.description: Three-letter Incoterm code defining the division of costs, risks, and responsibilities between shipper and consignee. Determines liability boundaries and insurance requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the cargo insurance policy covering this shipment. Used for claims processing in case of loss, damage, or delay.
attributes.references: International Union of Marine Insurance (IUMI) - Cargo Insurance Standards

attributes.name: is_dangerous_goods
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this shipment contains dangerous goods requiring special handling, storage, and documentation per IMDG Code. Triggers additional safety protocols and segregation requirements.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) - International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code

attributes.name: is_oversized
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this shipment contains oversized cargo exceeding standard container or vessel dimensions. Requires special handling equipment, berth planning, and route clearance.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Special Cargo Handling

attributes.name: is_reefer
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this shipment requires refrigeration (reefer container). Triggers temperature monitoring, power supply allocation, and specialized handling procedures.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Yard Management - Reefer Monitoring

attributes.name: is_transshipment
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this cargo is being transshipped (transferred to another vessel) rather than being delivered locally. Affects yard allocation, customs procedures, and operational workflow.

attributes.name: net_weight_mt
attributes.description: Net weight of the cargo excluding packaging and container tare weight, measured in metric tons. Used for customs valuation, trade statistics, and commercial invoicing.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) - Customs Valuation Standards

attributes.name: pod_port_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE five-character code identifying the port where the cargo will be discharged from the vessel. Determines berth allocation, discharge operations, and onward routing.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: pre_arrival_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when the shipment was first pre-advised to the port via COPARN or other EDI message. Enables advance planning for berth allocation, yard space, and resource scheduling.

attributes.name: shipment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the shipment in its lifecycle through the port. Tracks progression from pre-arrival notification through final delivery or transshipment. Updated by TOS and PCS systems as cargo moves through operational milestones. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Pre-Advised|In-Transit|Arrived|Discharged|Customs-Cleared|Ready-for-Delivery|Delivered|Transshipped — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special handling requirements or instructions for the cargo (e.g., fragile, keep upright, temperature-sensitive, security escort required). Communicated to operational teams.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Cargo Handling Standards

attributes.name: stowage_position
attributes.description: Six-digit bay-row-tier code indicating the cargo's stowage location on the vessel per BAPLIE standard. Used for discharge planning, load sequencing, and operational coordination with vessel crew.

attributes.name: temperature_setpoint_celsius
attributes.description: Required temperature setpoint in degrees Celsius for refrigerated cargo. Used to configure reefer container settings and monitor temperature compliance. Populated only when is_reefer is true.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Reefer Cargo Handling Standards

attributes.name: teu_count
attributes.description: Number of Twenty-foot Equivalent Units represented by this shipment. Standard measure for containerized cargo capacity. One 40-foot container equals 2.0 TEU. Used for port throughput statistics and capacity planning.
attributes.references: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) - ISO 668 Container Standards

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN number identifying the specific dangerous substance (e.g., UN1203 for gasoline). Used for emergency response, handling instructions, and regulatory compliance. Populated only for dangerous goods shipments.
attributes.references: United Nations - Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shipment record was last modified. Audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: volume_cbm
attributes.description: Total volume of the shipment measured in cubic meters. Critical for yard space allocation, warehouse planning, and volumetric billing calculations.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Cargo Measurement Standards

attributes.name: yard_location
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the specific yard block, row, and slot where the cargo is stored in the container yard or warehouse. Used for retrieval operations and inventory management.

SSOT for container identity and physical attributes within the terminal. Sourced from NAVIS N4 TOS.

Current_location_code is insufficient; zone_id provides structured

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.port_asset. Business justification: VGM (Verified Gross Mass) regulations require tracking which weighbridge equipment weighed each container. Port operations must maintain audit trail of calibrated weighing equipment used for SOLAS com

attributes.name: condition_grade
attributes.description: Physical condition grade assigned during inspection: A (excellent), B (good), C (fair - minor repairs needed), D (poor - major repairs needed), E (unserviceable). Used for maintenance planning and commercial decisions.

attributes.description: Unique container identification number in ISO 6346 format consisting of 4-letter owner code, 6-digit serial number, and 1 check digit. This is the globally recognized identifier for the physical container unit.

attributes.description: Current operational status of the container: full (loaded with cargo), empty (available for loading), damaged (requires inspection/repair), under_repair (in maintenance), retired (out of service), in_transit (moving between locations).

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: csc_plate_expiry_date

attributes.description: Expiry date of the CSC safety approval plate. Containers must be re-certified before this date to remain in service. Critical for regulatory compliance and port acceptance.

attributes.name: cubic_capacity_cbm
attributes.description: Internal cubic capacity of the container in cubic meters (CBM). Used for cargo stowage planning and freight calculations.

attributes.name: current_position_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the container was last positioned at its current location. Used for dwell time calculation and operational tracking.

attributes.name: delivery_order_number
attributes.description: Delivery Order number authorizing the release of the container to the consignee or their agent. Required for gate-out operations.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) Delivery Order Processing

attributes.name: final_destination_code
attributes.description: Five-character UN/LOCODE identifying the final inland destination for the container cargo. May differ from POD for transshipment or intermodal movements.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE (United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations)

attributes.name: gate_in_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the container entered the terminal through the gate. Marks the start of terminal custody and dwell time calculation.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS Gate Operations Module

attributes.name: gate_out_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the container exited the terminal through the gate. Marks the end of terminal custody and completion of dwell time.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS Gate Operations Module

attributes.name: hazmat_certification_number
attributes.description: Certification or approval number for containers authorized to carry dangerous goods. Null for non-certified or non-hazmat containers. Required for IMDG compliance.

attributes.name: height_ft
attributes.description: Physical height of the container in feet. Standard values: 8.5 ft (standard), 9.5 ft (high cube).

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the container holds dangerous goods requiring special handling, stowage, and documentation per IMDG Code. True if hazmat cargo present, False otherwise.
attributes.references: IMDG (International Maritime Dangerous Goods) Code; SOLAS Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: is_oversize
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the container carries oversize cargo extending beyond standard container dimensions (e.g., open top, flat rack with protruding cargo). Affects stowage planning and handling requirements.
attributes.references: Terminal Operating System (TOS) Oversize Cargo Handling Rules

attributes.name: is_overweight
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the container exceeds standard weight limits, requiring special handling equipment or stowage restrictions. Critical for crane operations and vessel stability.
attributes.references: SOLAS Container Weight Verification; Port Safety Standards

attributes.name: is_reefer
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the container is a refrigerated (reefer) unit requiring temperature control and power supply. True for reefer containers, False for dry containers.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS Reefer Management Module

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inspection of the container for structural integrity, condition grading, and safety compliance. Used to schedule periodic inspections and maintenance.
attributes.references: IICL Container Inspection Standards; Port Safety Regulations

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this container record was last updated in the terminal operating system. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS Data Management Standards

attributes.name: length_ft
attributes.description: Physical length of the container in feet. Standard values: 20, 40, 45 feet.

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date when the container was manufactured. Used to determine container age, depreciation, and remaining service life.

attributes.name: max_gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum allowable gross weight (container + cargo) in kilograms as per ISO standards. Typically 30,480 kg for standard containers.
attributes.references: ISO 668 Container Weight Standards; SOLAS Container Weight Verification

attributes.name: max_payload_kg
attributes.description: Maximum cargo weight capacity in kilograms, calculated as max gross weight minus tare weight. Represents the maximum cargo load the container can safely carry.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory container inspection. Ensures compliance with safety regulations and maintenance schedules.
attributes.references: IICL Container Inspection Standards; ISO 1496 Periodic Testing

attributes.name: owner_code
attributes.description: Four-letter code identifying the legal owner of the container. May differ from operator_code if container is leased.
attributes.references: Bureau International des Conteneurs (BIC) Owner Registry

attributes.name: pod_code
attributes.description: Five-character UN/LOCODE identifying the port where the container will be discharged from the vessel. Used for cargo routing and delivery planning.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE (United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations)

attributes.name: pol_code
attributes.description: Five-character UN/LOCODE identifying the port where the container was loaded onto the vessel. Used for cargo tracking and customs documentation.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE (United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations)

attributes.name: reefer_plug_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the reefer container requires electrical power connection at the terminal. True if plug-in required, False if not applicable or self-powered.

attributes.name: reefer_set_temp_celsius
attributes.description: Target temperature setting for refrigerated containers in degrees Celsius. Null for non-reefer containers. Critical for maintaining cargo cold chain integrity.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Reefer Management; Cold Chain Standards

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Unique seal number applied to the container door to ensure cargo security and detect tampering. Critical for customs clearance and cargo integrity verification.
attributes.references: ISO 17712 High Security Seals; ISPS Code Security Requirements

attributes.name: seal_type
attributes.description: Type of security seal applied: bolt (high security bolt seal), cable (cable seal), electronic (e-seal with tracking), barrier (barrier seal). Determines security level and customs acceptance.
attributes.references: ISO 17712 Seal Classification; WCO Security Standards

attributes.name: size_teu
attributes.description: Container size expressed in TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Units). Standard values: 1.0 for 20ft, 2.0 for 40ft, 2.25 for 45ft containers. Used for capacity planning and billing calculations.

attributes.name: swl_kg
attributes.description: Safe Working Load in kilograms - the maximum load that can be safely lifted by the container's lifting points. Critical for crane operations and cargo handling safety.
attributes.references: ISO 1496 Container Testing and Certification; Port Safety Regulations

attributes.name: tare_weight_kg
attributes.description: Empty weight of the container in kilograms. Used to calculate net cargo weight and verify VGM (Verified Gross Mass) compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 668 Container Weight Standards; SOLAS VGM Requirements

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: UN Number (United Nations Dangerous Goods Number)
attributes.description: Four-digit UN number identifying the specific dangerous substance (e.g., UN1203 for gasoline). Null for non-hazmat containers. Used for regulatory compliance and emergency response.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

products.name: manifest
products.description: Transactional record of the cargo manifest submitted per vessel call, including individual line items representing each BOL or container entry. Captures manifest number, vessel call reference, voyage number, manifest type (import/export/transshipment/coastal), submission date/time, submitting agent, total BOL count, total TEU count, total weight (MT), total CBM, customs submission status, PCS acknowledgement reference, amendment version, and manifest closure timestamp. Line-level detail includes BOL number, container number, cargo description, HS Code, package type/count, gross weight (KG), volume (CBM), shipper, consignee, POL, POD, freight terms, dangerous goods flag, IMDG class, UN number, temperature requirement, and customs declaration status.
