attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Post-resolution customer satisfaction rating provided by the customer, typically on a scale of 1 to 5. Captured via automated survey sent after case closure. Used for port service quality KPI reporting and continuous improvement programmes.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Customer Satisfaction; ISO 10002 - Customer Satisfaction; IAPH Port Performance Indicators

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the service request, complaint, dispute, or enquiry as provided by the customer. Captures the complete context of the issue including relevant operational details such as vessel name, container numbers, BOL references, or terminal locations.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Description; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: dispute_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value under dispute for billing disputes, demurrage (DMG) claims, detention (DET) charges, Terminal Handling Charge (THC) disputes, or wharfage (WHR) fee challenges. Null for non-financial service requests. Expressed in the port's operating currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Dispute Management; IAPH Tariff and Billing Standards

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service request has been formally escalated to a higher authority or management tier due to complexity, SLA breach, customer dissatisfaction, or regulatory implications (e.g., PSC complaint, ISPS security concern).
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Escalated; IAPH Customer Escalation Policy

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: The reason code for escalation of the service request. Supports root cause analysis of escalation patterns and identification of systemic operational issues.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Escalation Reason; IAPH Customer Service Framework

attributes.name: escalation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the service request was formally escalated. Null if escalation_flag is false. Used to track escalation response times and management intervention patterns.

attributes.name: imdg_related
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Related Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service request involves dangerous goods classified under the IMDG Code, including misdeclaration complaints, handling incidents, documentation disputes, or storage compliance issues for hazardous cargo.
attributes.references: IMDG Code - International Maritime Dangerous Goods; IMO MSC.122(75); SOLAS Chapter VII

tag_set.value: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Related Flag

attributes.name: isps_related
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Related Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service request relates to an ISPS Code security matter, including access control breaches, security level changes, security incidents, or ISPS compliance complaints. Triggers mandatory security officer review and potential regulatory notification.
attributes.references: ISPS Code - International Ship and Port Facility Security; IMO Resolution MSC.104(73); SOLAS Chapter XI-2

tag_set.value: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Related Flag

attributes.name: lodgement_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the service request was formally lodged by the customer or captured in the system. This is the principal business event timestamp and the anchor point for all SLA response time calculations.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Created On; ISO 8601

attributes.name: pcs_message_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the originating Port Community System (PCS) message (e.g., COPARN, IFTMIN, or stakeholder message) that triggered or is associated with this service request. Enables traceability back to the PCS transaction for EDI reconciliation.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) - Stakeholder Messaging; UN/EDIFACT COPARN; IFTMIN

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the service request, determining SLA response and resolution targets. Critical priority applies to vessel safety, ISPS security incidents, or cargo at imminent risk. High applies to operational disruptions affecting vessel or terminal schedules.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Priority; IMO SOLAS; ISPS Code

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to the service request at lodgement. Used in all customer-facing communications, Port Community System (PCS) messaging, and EDI exchanges. Format: SR-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Number; Port Community System (PCS) Messaging Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority to which this service request must be or has been notified (e.g., IMO, National Maritime Safety Authority, Port State Control, WCO, ILO). Populated when regulatory_notification_required is true.
attributes.references: IMO; ISPS Code Administration; National Maritime Safety Authority; PSC Authorities; WCO

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service request requires formal notification to a regulatory authority such as the National Maritime Safety Authority, Port State Control (PSC), IMO, or customs authority. Triggered for ISPS security incidents, MARPOL environmental complaints, SOLAS safety violations, or customs fraud allegations.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS; MARPOL Convention; ISPS Code; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities; WCO

attributes.name: reopen_count
attributes.description: Number of times this service request has been reopened after a previous resolution or closure. A high reopen count indicates unresolved root causes or customer dissatisfaction with the initial resolution. Used in quality and recurrence analysis.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Reopen Count; ISO 10002 - Complaints Handling

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the service request from lodgement through investigation to resolution. Drives workflow routing and SLA monitoring. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new|open|in_progress|pending_customer|resolved|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Status; IAPH Port Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: request_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the customer interaction. Distinguishes between general enquiries, formal complaints, billing disputes, operational service requests, incident reports, permit applications, and documentation requests. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: enquiry|complaint|dispute|service_request|incident_report|permit_application|documentation_request — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Type; IAPH Customer Service Framework

attributes.name: resolution_code
attributes.description: Standardised outcome code applied at case closure indicating how the service request was resolved (e.g., resolved_in_favour_of_customer, resolved_in_favour_of_port, partial_credit_issued, no_action_required, referred_to_regulator, withdrawn_by_customer). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: resolved_customer_favour|resolved_port_favour|partial_credit|no_action|referred_regulator|withdrawn|information_provided — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Resolution Code; IAPH Dispute Resolution Framework

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative documenting the resolution actions taken, findings of investigation, decisions made, and any remedial actions or credits applied. Captured by the assigned case handler at resolution. Forms part of the audit trail for regulatory and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Resolution Description; ISO 10002 - Customer Satisfaction Complaints Handling

attributes.name: resolved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the service request was formally resolved and a resolution communicated to the customer. Used to calculate total resolution time and SLA compliance for resolution targets.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Resolve By; IAPH Customer Service KPI Framework

attributes.name: sla_resolution_breached
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Resolution Breach Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SLA resolution target was breached for this service request. True if the resolved_timestamp exceeded sla_resolution_target or if the case remains unresolved past the target. Used for SLA compliance reporting and penalty calculations.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - SLA Breach; IAPH KPI Framework

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Resolution Breach Flag

attributes.name: sla_resolution_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Resolution Target Timestamp
attributes.description: The contractual deadline by which the port must fully resolve this service request, calculated from lodgement_timestamp based on the applicable SLA tier, request type, and priority level.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - SLA KPI; IAPH Port Service Level Agreement Standards

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Resolution Target Timestamp

attributes.name: sla_response_breached
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Breach Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SLA first-response target was breached for this service request. True if the acknowledged_timestamp exceeded sla_response_target or if no acknowledgement was sent before the target. Used for SLA compliance reporting and KPI dashboards.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - SLA Breach; IAPH KPI Framework

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Breach Flag

attributes.name: sla_response_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Target Timestamp
attributes.description: The contractual deadline by which the port must send an initial response to the customer for this service request, calculated from lodgement_timestamp based on the applicable SLA tier and priority level.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - SLA KPI; IAPH Port Service Level Agreement Standards

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Target Timestamp

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing granular context within the primary category. Examples include: THC dispute, demurrage claim, container damage, vessel delay, ISPS access, dangerous goods documentation, BOL amendment. Supports detailed analytics and specialist routing.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Sub-Category; NAVIS N4 TOS

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: Brief, descriptive title summarising the nature of the service request as provided by the customer or captured by the port agent at lodgement. Used in case lists, dashboards, and customer communications.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording when this service request record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 - Information Security; ISO 8601; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

products.name: credit_assessment
products.description: Credit assessment records for port community participants, capturing credit application details, assessed credit limit, credit rating, assessment methodology, supporting financial documents, assessor identity, assessment date, approval status, and next review date. Tracks credit history and limit changes over time. Used by the billing domain for credit control and by commercial teams for account onboarding decisions.
products.reference: CRM Credit Management / SAP FI Credit Control

attributes.name: credit_assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each credit assessment record within the port community participant credit management system.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management

attributes.name: participant_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.participant_account. Business justification: Credit assessments evaluate specific accounts, not just participants. Large shipping lines or freight forwarders maintain multiple accounts with different credit profiles, payment terms, and risk rati

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the port community participant (shipping line, freight forwarder, cargo owner, customs broker, trucking company, or port agent) for whom this credit assessment is conducted.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: annual_revenue
attributes.description: The port community participant's most recently reported annual revenue, sourced from submitted financial statements and used as a key input to the credit assessment and limit determination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: The date on which the port community participant formally submitted the credit application or the credit assessment was initiated by the commercial team.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credit assessment was formally approved by the authorised approver, marking the point from which the credit limit becomes effective.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: approval_level
attributes.description: The organisational approval authority level at which the credit assessment was approved, reflecting the port's delegated authority framework based on credit limit thresholds. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_officer|credit_manager|finance_director|cfo|board — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines; ISO 28000

attributes.name: approved_credit_limit
attributes.description: The final credit limit formally approved by the authorised approver, which may differ from the assessed limit following management review or escalation. This is the enforceable credit ceiling for the participant.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorised approver who approved or rejected the credit assessment, captured at the time of decision for audit trail and governance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Oracle HCM Cloud

attributes.name: assessed_credit_limit
attributes.description: The credit limit amount determined by the assessor following evaluation of the participant's financial standing, payment history, and risk profile. This is the operative limit used by the billing domain for credit control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credit assessor formally conducted and completed the credit evaluation, distinct from the application submission date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: assessment_methodology
attributes.description: The methodology or combination of methods used to conduct the credit assessment, such as financial statement analysis, external credit bureau reports, trade references, or the port's internal scoring model. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: financial_statement_analysis|credit_bureau_report|trade_reference|internal_scoring_model|combined|external_agency — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Basel III Credit Risk Framework

attributes.name: assessment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative notes recorded by the assessor documenting key findings, risk factors, qualitative observations, and rationale for the credit decision. Supports audit trail and future review context.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: assessment_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric reference number assigned to this credit assessment, used in correspondence with the port community participant and referenced in billing and commercial onboarding workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the credit assessment record, tracking its progression from initial submission through review, approval or rejection, and eventual expiry. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|rejected|expired|withdrawn — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the credit assessment indicating whether it is an initial assessment for new account onboarding, a scheduled periodic review, a triggered review due to payment behaviour changes, or a credit limit adjustment request. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initial|periodic_review|triggered_review|limit_increase|limit_decrease|onboarding — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the credit assessor who conducted the evaluation, captured at the time of assessment for audit and reporting purposes. Complements the assessor_employee_id for human-readable audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Oracle HCM Cloud

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this credit assessment record was first created in the system, used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; SAP S/4HANA FI; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: credit_bureau_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or report identifier from an external credit bureau or trade credit agency report obtained as part of the assessment process. Enables traceability back to the source credit report.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Basel III Credit Risk Framework

attributes.name: credit_insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of any trade credit insurance arrangement covering the port community participant's credit exposure, where the port has obtained insurance to mitigate default risk. Null if no insurance is in place.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines; P&I Club Insurance Standards

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: Internal credit rating assigned to the port community participant following assessment, using a standardised rating scale aligned with international credit rating conventions. Drives review frequency and credit terms. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AAA|AA|A|BBB|BB|B|CCC|CC|C|D — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines; Basel III Credit Risk Framework

attributes.name: credit_score
attributes.description: Numeric credit score derived from the assessment methodology, representing the port community participant's creditworthiness on the port's internal scoring scale. Used to determine credit rating tier and approved limit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Basel III Credit Risk Framework

attributes.name: crm_opportunity_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM opportunity or account onboarding record that initiated this credit assessment, enabling traceability between commercial pipeline activities and credit decisions.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the credit limits and financial assessments are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, AUD). Aligns with the port's billing currency configuration in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: days_past_due_count
attributes.description: The number of days the port community participant's outstanding invoices were past due at the time of assessment, sourced from SAP S/4HANA accounts receivable. A key input to the credit scoring model.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accounts Receivable; NAVIS N4 Billing

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which the assessed credit limit and terms become binding and active for the port community participant, used by the billing domain for credit control enforcement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Billing and Tariff Management

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current credit assessment expires and a review must be conducted. Nullable for open-ended credit arrangements. Triggers automated review workflow in the commercial team.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: financial_statement_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year of the financial statements submitted by the port community participant as supporting documentation for the credit assessment (e.g., 2023). Used to assess recency and relevance of financial data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: is_watch_list
attributes.description: Indicates whether the port community participant has been placed on the credit watch list due to deteriorating payment behaviour, adverse financial news, or elevated risk signals, triggering enhanced monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; ISPS Code; WCO Trade Compliance

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this credit assessment record was most recently modified, supporting audit trail, change tracking, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; SAP S/4HANA FI; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic credit review of the port community participant, set based on credit rating tier and risk policy. Used to trigger review workflows in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: The total outstanding accounts receivable balance owed by the port community participant at the time of the credit assessment, sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI. Used as a key input to limit utilisation and risk evaluation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accounts Receivable; NAVIS N4 Billing

attributes.name: payment_history_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative rating of the port community participant's historical payment behaviour based on analysis of invoice settlement patterns in SAP S/4HANA accounts receivable. A primary input to the credit scoring model.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accounts Receivable; NAVIS N4 Billing; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms code assigned to the port community participant based on the credit assessment outcome, defining the number of days allowed for invoice settlement (e.g., NET30, NET60, IMMEDIATE). Feeds directly into NAVIS N4 billing configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; NAVIS N4 Billing; Billing and Tariff Management

attributes.name: previous_credit_limit
attributes.description: The credit limit that was in effect prior to this assessment, enabling tracking of credit limit changes over time and trend analysis of the participant's credit standing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: previous_credit_rating
attributes.description: The credit rating assigned in the immediately preceding assessment, enabling tracking of rating migrations and trend analysis. Null for initial assessments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AAA|AA|A|BBB|BB|B|CCC|CC|C|D — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Basel III Credit Risk Framework

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Structured reason code or narrative explanation for the rejection of a credit application or reduction of a requested credit limit. Populated only when assessment_status is 'rejected'. Used for participant communication and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: requested_credit_limit
attributes.description: The credit limit amount requested by the port community participant in their credit application, expressed in the port's operating currency. Used as the baseline for the assessor's evaluation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Broad risk classification assigned to the port community participant based on the credit assessment outcome, used to determine credit control measures, payment terms, and security deposit requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Basel III Credit Risk Framework; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: sap_credit_account_number
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA customer credit account number associated with this assessment, enabling direct linkage between the credit assessment record and the operative credit master data in the ERP system.

attributes.name: security_deposit_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the security deposit required from the port community participant as a condition of credit approval, denominated in the currency specified by currency_code. Null if no deposit is required.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: security_deposit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the credit assessment outcome requires the port community participant to lodge a security deposit (cash, bank guarantee, or letter of credit) before credit facilities are activated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: security_deposit_type
attributes.description: The form of security instrument lodged or required from the port community participant as collateral for the credit facility, such as cash deposit, bank guarantee, or letter of credit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines; UCP 600 Letters of Credit

attributes.name: supporting_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document management system path for the supporting financial documents submitted with the credit application (e.g., audited financial statements, bank references, trade references). Enables document retrieval for audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: watch_list_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason the port community participant was placed on the credit watch list. Populated only when is_watch_list is True. Used for enhanced monitoring and escalation decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; ISPS Code

products.name: port_access_permit
products.description: Port access permits issued to port community participant personnel and vehicles, granting authorised access to restricted port zones in compliance with ISPS Code requirements. Captures permit holder (person or vehicle), permit type (personnel, vehicle, contractor), ISPS security zone access level, issuing authority, issue date, expiry date, biometric reference, and revocation status. Distinct from accreditation (which is entity-level) — this is individual-level access control.
products.reference: ISPS Port Access Control / Port Security Permit

attributes.name: port_access_permit_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each port access permit record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: contact_person_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.contact_person. Business justification: A port access permit is issued to a specific individual. When that individual is a registered contact person in the system (e.g., an operations manager, a truck driver registered as a contact), linkin

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.country. Business justification: Vendors providing on-site services (equipment maintenance, construction, stevedoring) require ISPS-compliant port access permits for personnel and vehicles entering restricted zones. Real business pro

attributes.name: isps_facility_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.isps_facility_record. Business justification: Port access permits must validate against ISPS facility security requirements and current security level. Port security officers require this link to enforce zone access restrictions based on facility

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the port community participant entity (shipping line, freight forwarder, trucking company, port agent, etc.) under whose sponsorship this permit was issued. Links to the customer master.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: port_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.port_location. Business justification: Access permits grant entry to specific terminals, berths, or ISPS security zones; physical access control enforcement, gate validation, and security zone management require precise location-level auth

attributes.name: sponsoring_vessel_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_master. Business justification: Under ISPS Code, port access permits for crew and vessel visitors are sponsored by a specific vessel. sponsoring_vessel_imo_number is a denormalized vessel reference; FK to vessel_master normalizes th

attributes.name: terminal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to terminal.terminal. Business justification: ISPS-compliant port access permits are issued per terminal (each terminal is a separate ISPS facility with distinct security perimeter). Permit records must track which terminal(s) the holder can acce

attributes.name: access_time_restriction
attributes.description: Time-of-day restriction applied to this permit. Unrestricted permits allow 24/7 access; other values limit access to defined operational windows. Enforced at gate entry systems and ISPS checkpoints.

attributes.name: application_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the original permit application submitted through the Port Community System (PCS) or port authority portal. Links the issued permit back to the application workflow for audit and traceability.

attributes.name: background_check_date
attributes.description: Date on which the security background check was completed for this permit holder. Used to determine whether a re-check is required at renewal based on the port's ISPS security policy interval.

attributes.name: background_check_status

attributes.name: badge_number
attributes.description: Physical badge or access card number printed on the permit holder's port ID badge. Used by gate access control systems, RFID readers, and security checkpoints to validate physical access. May differ from permit_number.

attributes.name: biometric_reference_code
attributes.description: Unique reference token linking this permit to the holder's biometric record stored in the port's secure biometric identity management system (fingerprint, iris, or facial recognition template). products.name: participant_service_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the commercial agreement between a port community participant and a specific port service. It captures negotiated pricing, discount structures, volume tiers, and payment terms that exist only in the context of this participant-service relationship. Each record links one port community participant to one service code with commercial terms that override standard tariff rates. This is the operational SSOT for participant-specific service pricing used by NAVIS N4 billing module and SAP FI/CO for invoice generation.. Existence Justification: In maritime port operations, participants (shipping lines, freight forwarders, cargo owners) subscribe to multiple port services (pilotage, towage, stevedoring, wharfage, storage), and each service is provided to multiple participants. The business actively manages participant-service agreements with negotiated rates, volume discounts, effective periods, and payment terms that vary by participant-service combination. This is a recognized commercial concept called Service Agreement or Tariff Agreement.

domains.name: tariff
domains.description: Owns the complete port services pricing catalog including THC (Terminal Handling Charges), wharfage (WHR), pilotage fees, demurrage (DMG), detention (DET), PIL, BAF, CAF, storage tariffs, and SLA-linked service rate cards. Covers rate cards, pricing rules, discount structures, and tariff schedules. SSOT for all commercial pricing and tariff definitions.

products.name: port_tariff
products.description: Master catalog of all port tariff schedules published by the port authority, organized by charge type discriminator. Supported charge types include THC (Terminal Handling Charges by container type/movement/zone), wharfage (WHR by cargo type/HS code/tonnage), pilotage (by LOA/GRT band/zone/time), towage (by GRT/DWT band/tug count/operation type), mooring (by LOA band/gang count/time), port dues (light dues, conservancy, anchorage by vessel GRT/flag), storage (by container status/type/zone with escalating bands), demurrage (DMG by container type/day with free time and escalation), and detention (DET for off-terminal equipment retention). Each record defines a named tariff schedule with its charge type classification, effective period, applicable trade lanes, vessel categories, cargo types, terminal zones, regulatory approval status, and filing reference. New charge types are added as new rows with a charge_type discriminator — no schema changes required. Supports multiple concurrent schedules per charge type. This is the SSOT for all tariff schedule definitions — individual charge amounts are held in tariff_item.

products.description: Individual line-item charge definition within a port tariff schedule. products.name: rate_card
products.description: Negotiated or published rate card defining specific pricing applicable to a customer segment, shipping line, cargo owner, or trade lane. A rate card references one or more tariff items and overrides or discounts the base tariff rates for a defined period. Supports standard commercial rate cards and SLA-linked rate cards with service performance tiers (Gold/Silver/Bronze), committed KPIs (vessel turnaround time, crane productivity moves/hour, gate processing time), penalty/premium clauses, measurement periods, and escalation clauses. Captures rate card name, version, effective and expiry dates, applicable customer tier, trade lane, service type, SLA tier (if applicable), currency, approval workflow status, and link to originating tariff_negotiation. An SLA tier discriminator distinguishes standard rate cards from performance-linked rate cards — no separate entity required. Serves as the commercial pricing instrument linking the tariff catalog to customer agreements and SLA-based billing adjustments.

products.name: item_surcharge_applicability
products.description: This association product represents the formal applicability rules between base tariff items and surcharge rules in port tariff administration. It captures which surcharges (BAF, CAF, ISPS, peak season, etc.) apply to which base charge items, with specific calculation priorities, effective periods, and override conditions for each combination. Each record links one tariff item to one surcharge rule with attributes that govern how the surcharge is applied to that specific charge type. This is a formally managed business concept in maritime tariff publishing, where port authorities explicitly define and version surcharge applicability matrices.. Existence Justification: In port tariff administration, surcharge applicability is a formally managed business concept where port authorities explicitly define which surcharges (BAF, CAF, ISPS, peak season) apply to which base tariff items. A single tariff item (e.g., THC per TEU) can have multiple surcharges applied to it simultaneously (BAF + CAF + ISPS), and a single surcharge rule (e.g., BAF) applies to multiple different charge types (THC, wharfage, pilotage, storage). The relationship itself carries business data including calculation priority (order of application), applicability conditions (specific to each item-surcharge pair), and effective dates (surcharges are rolled out to different charge types at different times).

products.name: receivable_account
products.description: The single authoritative customer billing and accounts receivable master for each port community participant — THE unified customer record for all billing, credit management, and collections operations in this domain. Combines billing configuration (invoice delivery method, EDI partner ID, preferred currency, payment terms net 7/14/30/60, billing cycle vessel-call/weekly/monthly, account manager, billing address) with financial position tracking (credit limit, outstanding balance, aging buckets 0-30/31-60/61-90/90+ days, dunning level, credit hold flag, average days to pay). Captures account code, SAP customer account number (KNA1/KNB1), account name, VAT/tax registration, account classification (shipping line/freight forwarder/cargo owner/terminal operator/government), account status (active/suspended/blocked/closed), last payment date, credit rating, and EDI partner configuration. SSOT for customer identity, billing preferences, credit exposure, AR aging, and settlement terms. All invoices, payments, disputes, adjustments, dunning notices, and statements reference this single master.

products.name: charge_event
products.description: Granular chargeable service events captured from NAVIS N4 TOS and other operational systems, representing all raw billable activities before invoice consolidation. Covers commercial charges (container moves, gate transactions, crane hire, reefer connections, hazardous handling, storage days) and statutory/regulatory charges (wharfage assessments based on cargo weight/volume, port dues based on vessel GRT/NRT, pilotage levies, navigation fees). Also captures demurrage and detention charge calculations including free time start/end, excess days, and daily rates. Captures charge event reference, event type, event timestamp, container number, vessel call ID, vessel IMO/GRT/NRT, BOL number, cargo weight/volume, equipment ID, quantity, unit of measure, applicable tariff code, calculated charge amount, currency, billing status (unbilled/billed/disputed/waived), exemption flag, free time days allowed, excess days, statutory authority reference, and source system reference. SSOT for all pre-invoice chargeable activity including commercial, statutory, and demurrage/detention charges.
products.reference: NAVIS N4 - Charge Event / TOS Billable Activity

domains.name: compliance
domains.description: Manages customs clearance, trade documentation, regulatory filings, ISPS security compliance, PSC (Port State Control) inspections, HS Code validation, sanctions screening, import/export controls, and EDI messaging (IFTMIN). Covers customs integration via Port Community System and regulatory reporting to WCO, IMO, and national maritime authorities. SSOT for trade compliance and regulatory adherence.

products.name: customs_declaration
products.description: Core transactional record of import/export customs declarations submitted to national customs authorities via the Port Community System (PCS). Captures declaration type (import/export/transit), declarant details, HS codes, cargo description, declared value, duty amounts, VAT, customs regime, declaration status lifecycle (submitted/assessed/cleared/rejected/cancelled), customs reference number, BOL reference, vessel call reference, port of loading (POL), port of discharge (POD), country of origin, country of destination, incoterms, consignee, consignor, freight forwarder, broker license number, submission timestamp, assessment timestamp, clearance timestamp, and WCO message standard version (WCO Data Model 3.x). SSOT for all customs clearance events processed through the port. Supports IMO FAL Form 3 (Cargo Declaration) reporting obligations.
products.reference: WCO Data Model / SAD (Single Administrative Document)

products.name: hs_code
products.description: Reference master for Harmonized System (HS) commodity classification codes as maintained by the World Customs Organization (WCO). Captures HS code (6-digit international + national extension), commodity description, chapter, heading, subheading, duty rate, VAT rate, prohibited/restricted flag, IMDG dangerous goods flag, CITES flag, dual-use flag, applicable trade controls, effective date, expiry date, and issuing authority. Used for customs declaration validation, duty calculation, and trade compliance screening across all cargo movements.

DoS records capture DoS reference number, vessel IMO number, DoS type (ship-to-port/ship-to-ship), activities covered, validity periods, signing officers (ship and port side), and signing timestamps. SSOT for all ISPS security compliance at the port facility level including DoS lifecycle management, security incident response, MARSEC level changes, and national maritime security centre reporting.

Captures vessel IMO number, operation type, quantities, officer signatures, port authority endorsement, compliance status, and associated PSC inspection reference. SSOT for all MARPOL, BWM Convention, and port waste reception compliance documentation at the port.

Captures broker company name, license number and type, issuing authority, license validity period, license status (active/suspended/revoked/expired), authorized ports of operation, primary contact details, EDI sender ID, PCS registration reference, compliance rating, and performance metrics. attributes.description: Type or code of the hazard label required for containers and packages carrying goods of this IMDG class (e.g., 'Explosive 1.1', 'Flammable Gas', 'Toxic'). Used for visual identification and compliance with labeling regulations.
attributes.references: IMO IMDG Code Part 5 - Consignment Procedures

attributes.name: imdg_code_amendment_cycle
attributes.description: Amendment cycle or version of the IMDG Code under which this classification is defined (e.g., 'Amendment 40-20', 'Amendment 41-22'). The IMDG Code is updated biennially; this field tracks which amendment cycle applies to this record.

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: Date when this IMDG classification record was last verified against the current IMO IMDG Code amendment. Used to ensure data currency and compliance with the latest regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: limited_quantity_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum quantity per package or inner packaging that qualifies for limited quantity (LQ) exemptions under the IMDG Code. Expressed as a volume or mass (e.g., '1L', '5kg'). Limited quantities are subject to reduced regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: IMO IMDG Code Part 3 - Limited Quantities

attributes.name: marine_pollutant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether substances in this IMDG class are classified as marine pollutants under MARPOL Annex III. True if the class typically contains marine pollutants requiring special marking and documentation.

attributes.name: marpol_annex_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the applicable MARPOL annex for pollution prevention related to this IMDG class (e.g., 'Annex I - Oil', 'Annex II - Noxious Liquid Substances', 'Annex III - Harmful Substances in Packaged Form'). Used for environmental compliance and spill response planning.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IMDG classification record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or additional guidance related to this IMDG class. May include port-specific handling instructions, local regulatory variations, or clarifications for operational staff.

attributes.name: packing_group
attributes.description: Packing group classification (I, II, or III) indicating the degree of danger: I = high danger, II = medium danger, III = low danger. Used to determine packaging specifications and handling requirements.

attributes.name: segregation_group_code
attributes.description: Segregation group code assigned to this IMDG class for stowage and segregation purposes (e.g., acids, alkalis, ammonium compounds). Used to determine compatibility and separation requirements in vessel stowage planning and yard block allocation.
attributes.references: IMO IMDG Code Part 7 - Stowage and Segregation

attributes.name: segregation_table_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the segregation table in the IMDG Code specifying separation requirements (e.g., 'away from', 'separated from', 'separated by a complete compartment or hold from'). Defines minimum physical separation distances for safe stowage.
attributes.references: IMO IMDG Code Part 7 - Segregation Table

attributes.name: solas_regulation_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) Regulation Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the applicable SOLAS Chapter VII regulation governing the carriage of this dangerous goods class by sea (e.g., 'SOLAS Ch.VII Part A', 'SOLAS Ch.VII Part B'). SOLAS Chapter VII addresses the carriage of dangerous goods in packaged form or in solid form in bulk.

tag_set.value: Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS) Regulation Reference

attributes.name: special_provisions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of special provision codes applicable to this IMDG class (e.g., SP23, SP172, SP274). Special provisions modify or supplement the general requirements for specific substances or articles within the class.
attributes.references: IMO IMDG Code Part 3 - Dangerous Goods List Special Provisions

attributes.name: stowage_category
attributes.description: Stowage category code (A, B, C, D, or E) defining where this IMDG class may be stowed on a vessel. Category A = on deck or under deck; B = on deck or under deck with specific conditions; C = on deck only; D = on deck only with specific conditions; E = prohibited from carriage. Used in BAPLIE stowage planning.
attributes.references: IMO IMDG Code Part 7 - Stowage and Segregation

attributes.name: un_number_range_end
attributes.description: Ending UN number in the range typically associated with this IMDG class. Defines the upper bound of UN numbers commonly classified under this hazard class.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: un_number_range_start
attributes.description: Starting UN number in the range typically associated with this IMDG class. UN numbers are four-digit identifiers assigned to hazardous substances and articles by the United Nations Committee of Experts on the Transport of Dangerous Goods.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Effective start date for this IMDG classification record. Used to manage amendment transitions and ensure the correct classification rules are applied based on the cargo acceptance or vessel departure date.

attributes.name: valid_to
attributes.description: Effective end date for this IMDG classification record. Nullable for current/active classifications. Used to manage historical records when IMDG Code amendments supersede or modify classifications.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_shipping_ports_v1`.`_metrics`.`asset_failure_report`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Asset failure and incident metrics tracking failure patterns, severity, recurrence, and operational impact to drive reliability improvements."
  source: "`vibe_shipping_ports_v1`.`asset`.`failure_report`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "failure_severity"
      expr: failure_severity
      comment: "Severity classification of the failure"
    - name: "failure_mode"
      expr: failure_mode
      comment: "Mode or mechanism of failure"
    - name: "failure_class"
      expr: failure_class
      comment: "Classification category of the failure"
    - name: "root_cause"
      expr: root_cause
      comment: "Identified root cause of the failure"
    - name: "affected_system"
      expr: affected_system
      comment: "System affected by the failure"
    - name: "affected_component"
      expr: affected_component
      comment: "Component affected by the failure"
    - name: "priority"
      expr: priority
      comment: "Priority level assigned to the failure"
    - name: "report_status"
      expr: report_status
      comment: "Current status of the failure report"
    - name: "failure_recurrence_flag"
      expr: failure_recurrence_flag
      comment: "Whether this is a recurring failure"
    - name: "safety_incident_flag"
      expr: safety_incident_flag
      comment: "Whether failure resulted in a safety incident"
    - name: "environmental_impact_flag"
      expr: environmental_impact_flag
      comment: "Whether failure had environmental impact"
    - name: "swl_exceeded_flag"
      expr: swl_exceeded_flag
      comment: "Whether safe working load was exceeded at time of failure"
    - name: "warranty_claim_eligible_flag"
      expr: warranty_claim_eligible_flag
      comment: "Whether failure is eligible for warranty claim"
    - name: "failure_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', failure_datetime)
      comment: "Month when failure occurred"
  measures:
    - name: "total_failures"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of asset failures reported"
    - name: "total_downtime_hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(downtime_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total downtime hours caused by failures"
    - name: "avg_downtime_per_failure"
      expr: AVG(CAST(downtime_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average downtime hours per failure event"
    - name: "total_estimated_repair_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_repair_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated cost to repair all failures"
    - name: "avg_repair_cost_per_failure"
      expr: AVG(CAST(estimated_repair_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average estimated repair cost per failure"
    - name: "avg_cycles_at_failure"
      expr: AVG(CAST(cycles_at_failure AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average number of operating cycles at time of failure"
    - name: "avg_operating_hours_at_failure"
      expr: AVG(CAST(operating_hours_at_failure AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average operating hours accumulated at time of failure"
    - name: "failure_recurrence_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN failure_recurrence_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of failures that are recurring issues"
    - name: "safety_incident_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN safety_incident_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of failures resulting in safety incidents"
    - name: "environmental_impact_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN environmental_impact_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of failures with environmental impact"
    - name: "swl_violation_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN swl_exceeded_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of failures where safe working load was exceeded"
    - name: "warranty_eligible_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN warranty_claim_eligible_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of failures eligible for warranty claims"
    - name: "avg_load_at_failure_tonnes"
      expr: AVG(CAST(load_at_failure_tonnes AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average load in tonnes at time of failure"
$$
metric_views.description: Asset failure and incident metrics tracking failure patterns, severity, recurrence, and operational impact to drive reliability improvements.

      expr: inspector_authority
      comment: "Authority or organization conducting the inspection"

      expr: defect_severity_highest

    - name: "inspection_scope"
      expr: inspection_scope

    - name: "avg_inspection_cost"

    - name: "avg_defects_per_inspection"

    - name: "avg_load_test_weight_tonnes"

    - name: "avg_swl_rating_verified_tonnes"
      expr: AVG(CAST(swl_rating_verified AS DOUBLE))

  dimensions:

    - name: "regulatory_requirement"

      comment: "Seasonal adjustment applied to the maintenance schedule"

    - name: "total_maintenance_plans"

      comment: "Total number of maintenance plans"
    - name: "active_plans_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN plan_status = 'Active' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of currently active maintenance plans"
    - name: "total_estimated_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated cost of all maintenance plans"
    - name: "avg_estimated_cost_per_plan"
      expr: AVG(CAST(estimated_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average estimated cost per maintenance plan"
    - name: "total_estimated_downtime_hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_downtime_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated downtime hours for all planned maintenance"
    - name: "avg_estimated_downtime_per_plan"
      expr: AVG(CAST(estimated_downtime_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average estimated downtime hours per maintenance plan"
    - name: "total_estimated_labour_hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_labor_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated labor hours for all maintenance plans"
    - name: "avg_estimated_labour_per_plan"
      expr: AVG(CAST(estimated_labor_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average estimated labor hours per maintenance plan"
    - name: "plan_adherence_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN last_completed_date IS NOT NULL AND last_completed_date <= next_due_date THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN last_completed_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of maintenance plans completed on or before due date"
    - name: "overdue_plans_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN next_due_date < CURRENT_DATE() AND plan_status = 'Active' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of active maintenance plans currently overdue"
    - name: "regulatory_compliance_plans_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN regulatory_requirement IS NOT NULL AND regulatory_requirement != '' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of maintenance plans driven by regulatory requirements"
    - name: "certification_required_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN compliance_certificate_required = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of maintenance plans requiring compliance certification"
$$
metric_views.description: Preventive maintenance planning and execution metrics tracking plan adherence, resource requirements, and maintenance effectiveness.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_shipping_ports_v1`.`_metrics`.`asset_port_asset`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$

  comment: "Core asset performance and financial metrics for port infrastructure and equipment, tracking utilization, reliability, and asset value."
  source: "`vibe_shipping_ports_v1`.`asset`.`port_asset`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "asset_category"

      expr: asset_status

      expr: maintenance_strategy

    - name: "depreciation_method"
      expr: depreciation_method
      comment: "Accounting depreciation method used"
    - name: "capex_classification"
      expr: capex_classification
      comment: "Capital expenditure classification"
    - name: "commissioning_year"
      expr: YEAR(commissioning_date)
      comment: "Year the asset was commissioned"
    - name: "environmental_compliance_flag"
      expr: environmental_compliance_flag
      comment: "Whether asset meets environmental compliance standards"
  measures:
    - name: "total_asset_count"

    - name: "total_acquisition_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(acquisition_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total capital invested in acquiring assets"
    - name: "total_current_book_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(current_book_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total current book value of all assets"
    - name: "total_residual_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(residual_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated residual value of assets at end of useful life"
    - name: "avg_asset_age_years"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), commissioning_date) / 365.25)
      comment: "Average age of assets in years since commissioning"
    - name: "total_operating_hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(operating_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total operating hours across all assets"
    - name: "avg_operating_hours_per_asset"
      expr: AVG(CAST(operating_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average operating hours per asset"
    - name: "avg_mtbf_hours"
      expr: AVG(CAST(mean_time_between_failures AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average mean time between failures across assets, indicating reliability"
    - name: "avg_mttr_hours"
      expr: AVG(CAST(mean_time_to_repair AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average mean time to repair across assets, indicating maintainability"
    - name: "asset_availability_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CAST(mean_time_between_failures AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(mean_time_between_failures AS DOUBLE) + CAST(mean_time_to_repair AS DOUBLE), 0)), 2)
      comment: "Average asset availability percentage based on MTBF and MTTR"
    - name: "depreciation_rate_pct"

    - name: "total_swl_capacity_tonnes"
      expr: SUM(CAST(swl_rating AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total safe working load capacity across all assets in tonnes"

      comment: "Total value of spare parts inventory on hand"

      comment: "Average unit cost per spare part"
    - name: "inventory_turnover_ratio"

      comment: "Percentage of parts below minimum stock level indicating stockout risk"

      comment: "Percentage of parts with inventory exceeding twice the reorder point"

      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN criticality_classification = 'Critical' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of spare parts classified as critical"
    - name: "hazardous_parts_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN hazardous_material_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of spare parts classified as hazardous materials"
    - name: "obsolete_parts_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN obsolescence_status = 'Obsolete' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of spare parts marked as obsolete"
    - name: "avg_lead_time_days"
      expr: AVG(CAST(lead_time_days AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average lead time in days to procure spare parts"
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_shipping_ports_v1`.`_metrics`.`intermodal_drayage_order`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Strategic drayage operations KPIs tracking container movement efficiency, on-time performance, hazmat handling, and service quality for first/last-mile port logistics"
  source: "`vibe_shipping_ports_v1`.`intermodal`.`drayage_order`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "drayage_status"
      expr: drayage_status
      comment: "Current status of the drayage order (e.g., scheduled, in-transit, completed, cancelled)"
    - name: "drayage_type"
      expr: drayage_type
      comment: "Type of drayage movement (e.g., import, export, street turn, repositioning)"
    - name: "origin_location_type"
      expr: origin_location_type
      comment: "Type of origin location (e.g., port terminal, warehouse, rail yard, customer site)"
    - name: "destination_location_type"
      expr: destination_location_type
      comment: "Type of destination location for delivery"
    - name: "hazmat_indicator"
      expr: hazmat_indicator
      comment: "Whether the drayage order involves hazardous materials requiring special handling"
    - name: "reefer_indicator"
      expr: reefer_indicator
      comment: "Whether the container requires refrigeration"
    - name: "overweight_indicator"
      expr: overweight_indicator
      comment: "Whether the container exceeds standard weight limits"
    - name: "order_priority"
      expr: order_priority
      comment: "Priority level of the drayage order (e.g., standard, expedited, urgent)"
    - name: "proof_of_delivery_received"
      expr: proof_of_delivery_received
      comment: "Whether proof of delivery documentation has been received"
    - name: "scheduled_pickup_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', scheduled_pickup_date)
      comment: "Month of scheduled pickup for trend analysis"
    - name: "scheduled_delivery_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', scheduled_delivery_date)
      comment: "Month of scheduled delivery for trend analysis"
  measures:
    - name: "total_drayage_orders"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of drayage orders - baseline volume metric for capacity planning and demand forecasting"
    - name: "unique_containers_moved"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT container_id)
      comment: "Distinct containers handled - measures actual container throughput and asset utilization"
    - name: "on_time_pickup_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_pickup_timestamp <= scheduled_pickup_time_window_end THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of pickups completed within scheduled time window - measures carrier reliability and schedule adherence"
    - name: "on_time_delivery_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_delivery_timestamp <= scheduled_delivery_time_window_end THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of deliveries completed within scheduled time window - critical SLA performance indicator"
    - name: "late_pickup_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_pickup_timestamp > scheduled_pickup_time_window_end THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of late pickups - identifies operational bottlenecks and carrier performance issues"
    - name: "late_delivery_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_delivery_timestamp > scheduled_delivery_time_window_end THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of late deliveries - tracks customer service failures and potential penalty exposure"
    - name: "hazmat_order_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN hazmat_indicator = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of hazardous material orders - critical for safety compliance, resource allocation, and risk management"
    - name: "reefer_order_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN reefer_indicator = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of refrigerated container orders - tracks specialized equipment demand and cold chain capacity"
    - name: "overweight_order_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN overweight_indicator = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of overweight container orders - identifies need for specialized equipment and permits"
    - name: "cancelled_order_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN cancellation_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of cancelled orders - measures operational disruption and customer commitment reliability"
    - name: "failed_order_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN failure_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of failed drayage attempts - critical quality metric for root cause analysis and process improvement"
    - name: "total_verified_gross_mass_kg"
      expr: SUM(CAST(verified_gross_mass_kg AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total verified gross mass in kilograms - measures cargo weight throughput for capacity planning and safety compliance"
    - name: "avg_verified_gross_mass_kg"
      expr: AVG(CAST(verified_gross_mass_kg AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average verified gross mass per order - identifies typical load characteristics and equipment requirements"
$$
metric_views.description: Strategic drayage operations KPIs tracking container movement efficiency, on-time performance, hazmat handling, and service quality for first/last-mile port logistics

      expr: SUM(CAST(fuel_consumed_litres AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total fuel consumed across all tug assignments in litres"

    - name: "avg_current_speed_knots"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_shipping_ports_v1`.`_metrics`.`masterdata_commodity_code`

  comment: "Commodity regulatory compliance and handling complexity metrics for risk management and operational planning"

  dimensions:
    - name: "commodity_code_status"
      expr: commodity_code_status
      comment: "Status of the commodity code (active, deprecated, pending)"
    - name: "hs_chapter"
      expr: hs_chapter
      comment: "Harmonized System chapter for trade classification"
    - name: "packing_group"
      expr: packing_group
      comment: "Packing group for dangerous goods classification"
    - name: "segregation_group"
      expr: segregation_group
      comment: "Segregation group for cargo stowage planning"
    - name: "storage_area_type"
      expr: storage_area_type
      comment: "Required storage area type for yard planning"
    - name: "handling_method"
      expr: handling_method
      comment: "Required handling method for operational procedures"
    - name: "marpol_category"
      expr: marpol_category
      comment: "MARPOL category for environmental compliance"
    - name: "regulatory_complexity"
      expr: CASE WHEN export_license_required = TRUE AND import_license_required = TRUE THEN 'High Regulatory' WHEN export_license_required = TRUE OR import_license_required = TRUE THEN 'Medium Regulatory' ELSE 'Standard' END
      comment: "Regulatory complexity tier for customs and compliance planning"
    - name: "handling_complexity"
      expr: CASE WHEN temperature_controlled = TRUE AND fumigation_required = TRUE AND quarantine_required = TRUE THEN 'High Complexity' WHEN temperature_controlled = TRUE OR fumigation_required = TRUE OR quarantine_required = TRUE THEN 'Medium Complexity' ELSE 'Standard' END
      comment: "Handling complexity tier for operational resource allocation"

      expr: CASE WHEN marine_pollutant = TRUE AND excepted_quantity = FALSE THEN 'High Hazard' WHEN marine_pollutant = TRUE OR excepted_quantity = FALSE THEN 'Medium Hazard' ELSE 'Low Hazard' END

    - name: "total_commodity_codes"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT commodity_code_id)

      comment: "Percentage of commodities flagged as prohibited - regulatory risk indicator"
    - name: "export_license_required_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN export_license_required = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of commodities requiring export license - trade compliance complexity"
    - name: "import_license_required_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN import_license_required = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of commodities requiring import license - customs clearance complexity"
    - name: "temperature_controlled_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN temperature_controlled = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of commodities requiring temperature control - reefer infrastructure demand"
    - name: "fumigation_required_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN fumigation_required = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of commodities requiring fumigation - biosecurity service demand"
    - name: "quarantine_required_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN quarantine_required = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of commodities requiring quarantine - inspection facility capacity planning"
    - name: "marine_pollutant_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN marine_pollutant = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of commodities classified as marine pollutants - environmental risk metric"
    - name: "avg_tariff_rate_percent"

      comment: "Average tariff rate for trade cost modeling and competitiveness analysis"
    - name: "avg_flash_point_celsius"

      comment: "Average flash point for fire safety risk assessment"
    - name: "avg_temp_range_min_celsius"

      comment: "Average minimum temperature requirement for reefer capacity planning"
    - name: "avg_temp_range_max_celsius"
      expr: AVG(CAST(temperature_range_max_celsius AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average maximum temperature requirement for reefer capacity planning"

    - name: "total_monthly_vessel_calls"
      expr: SUM(CAST(average_vessel_calls_per_month AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total monthly vessel calls across all shipping lines for port throughput capacity planning"
    - name: "isps_compliance_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN isps_compliant_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of shipping lines ISPS compliant - security risk indicator"
    - name: "dangerous_goods_approval_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN dangerous_goods_approved_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)

    - name: "reefer_capability_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN reefer_capable_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)

    - name: "api_integration_rate"

    - name: "edi_integration_rate"

    - name: "full_digital_integration_rate"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_shipping_ports_v1`.`_metrics`.`masterdata_vessel_master`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Core vessel fleet performance and compliance metrics for operational and strategic decision-making"
  source: "`vibe_shipping_ports_v1`.`masterdata`.`vessel_master`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "operational_status"
      expr: operational_status
      comment: "Current operational status of the vessel (active, inactive, under maintenance)"
    - name: "flag_state"
      expr: flag_state_id
      comment: "Flag state identifier for regulatory and compliance segmentation"
    - name: "vessel_type"
      expr: vessel_type_id
      comment: "Vessel type identifier for fleet composition analysis"
    - name: "ice_class"
      expr: ice_class
      comment: "Ice class rating for operational capability segmentation"
    - name: "classification_society"
      expr: classification_society_code
      comment: "Classification society code for quality and compliance tracking"
    - name: "compliance_status"
      expr: CASE WHEN isps_compliant = TRUE AND marpol_compliant = TRUE AND solas_compliant = TRUE THEN 'Fully Compliant' WHEN isps_compliant = FALSE OR marpol_compliant = FALSE OR solas_compliant = FALSE THEN 'Non-Compliant' ELSE 'Unknown' END
      comment: "Consolidated compliance status across ISPS, MARPOL, and SOLAS regulations"
    - name: "vessel_age_category"
      expr: CASE WHEN CAST(year_built AS INT) >= YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) - 5 THEN 'New (0-5 years)' WHEN CAST(year_built AS INT) >= YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) - 15 THEN 'Modern (6-15 years)' WHEN CAST(year_built AS INT) >= YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) - 25 THEN 'Mature (16-25 years)' ELSE 'Aging (25+ years)' END
      comment: "Vessel age category for fleet modernization and replacement planning"
    - name: "capacity_tier"
      expr: CASE WHEN CAST(teu_capacity AS INT) >= 10000 THEN 'Ultra Large (10k+ TEU)' WHEN CAST(teu_capacity AS INT) >= 5000 THEN 'Large (5k-10k TEU)' WHEN CAST(teu_capacity AS INT) >= 2000 THEN 'Medium (2k-5k TEU)' WHEN CAST(teu_capacity AS INT) > 0 THEN 'Small (<2k TEU)' ELSE 'Non-Container' END
      comment: "TEU capacity tier for fleet capacity planning and berth allocation"
    - name: "psc_risk_category"
      expr: CASE WHEN CAST(psc_deficiency_count AS INT) = 0 THEN 'Low Risk' WHEN CAST(psc_deficiency_count AS INT) <= 5 THEN 'Medium Risk' WHEN CAST(psc_deficiency_count AS INT) > 5 THEN 'High Risk' ELSE 'Unknown' END
      comment: "Port State Control risk category based on deficiency count"
  measures:
    - name: "total_fleet_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT vessel_master_id)
      comment: "Total number of unique vessels in the fleet for capacity planning"
    - name: "total_teu_capacity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(teu_capacity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total TEU capacity across the fleet for strategic capacity management"
    - name: "total_dwt_capacity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(summer_dwt AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total deadweight tonnage capacity for cargo volume planning"
    - name: "total_grt"
      expr: SUM(CAST(grt AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross registered tonnage for regulatory and port fee calculations"
    - name: "avg_vessel_age_years"
      expr: AVG(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) - CAST(year_built AS INT))
      comment: "Average vessel age in years for fleet modernization strategy"
    - name: "avg_teu_per_vessel"
      expr: AVG(CAST(teu_capacity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average TEU capacity per vessel for fleet efficiency benchmarking"
    - name: "avg_dwt_per_vessel"
      expr: AVG(CAST(summer_dwt AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average deadweight tonnage per vessel for operational efficiency analysis"
    - name: "compliance_rate_isps"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN isps_compliant = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of fleet compliant with ISPS security standards - critical for port access"
    - name: "compliance_rate_marpol"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN marpol_compliant = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of fleet compliant with MARPOL environmental standards - regulatory risk indicator"
    - name: "compliance_rate_solas"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN solas_compliant = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of fleet compliant with SOLAS safety standards - operational risk metric"
    - name: "full_compliance_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN isps_compliant = TRUE AND marpol_compliant = TRUE AND solas_compliant = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of fleet fully compliant across all three major regulations - executive KPI for regulatory risk"
    - name: "avg_psc_deficiencies"
      expr: AVG(CAST(psc_deficiency_count AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average Port State Control deficiency count per vessel - quality and safety performance indicator"
    - name: "total_propulsion_power_mw"
      expr: SUM(CAST(propulsion_power_kw AS DOUBLE)) / 1000.0
      comment: "Total propulsion power in megawatts for fuel cost modeling and environmental impact assessment"
    - name: "avg_beam_meters"
      expr: AVG(CAST(beam_meters AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average vessel beam for berth compatibility and infrastructure planning"
    - name: "avg_loa_meters"
      expr: AVG(CAST(loa_meters AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average length overall for berth allocation and port infrastructure requirements"
    - name: "avg_draft_meters"
      expr: AVG(CAST(maximum_draft_meters AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average maximum draft for channel depth and dredging investment decisions"
$$
metric_views.description: Core vessel fleet performance and compliance metrics for operational and strategic decision-making
